title: nan
authors: Yue W.; Wang Y.; Zhang X.; Wang L.; Liu Z.; Li L.; Zhu L.
key_contribution: Proposes I-ACPM, a UAV swarm distributed cooperative localization strategy combining ICMC clustering and ant colony pheromone fusion for GNSS-denied environments, validated in simulation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Multi_Agent_Collaborative_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
